title: Five Killed After Amazon Cargo Plane Crashes at Miami Airport
subtitle: A Boeing 767 cargo aircraft overran a runway and struck vehicles, leading to a major emergency response and airport closures.

summary.en: An Amazon cargo plane crashed at Miami International Airport on Sunday afternoon after overrunning the runway. At least five people were killed, and several others were injured during the incident. The aircraft, a Boeing 767, caught fire and hit multiple vehicles near the airport grounds. Emergency teams worked for hours to manage a fuel leak and rescue those trapped in the wreckage. Federal authorities have launched an investigation to determine the cause of the crash.
summary.zh: 週日下午，一架亞馬遜貨機在邁阿密國際機場降落時衝出跑道並墜毀。這起事故造成至少五人死亡，多人受傷。該架波音七六七飛機起火燃燒，並撞擊機場地面附近的多輛車輛。緊急救援小組耗時數小時處理燃油外洩並救出受困於殘骸中的人員。聯邦當局已啟動調查，以釐清墜機原因。

paragraphs.en: A serious accident occurred at Miami International Airport on Sunday when an Amazon cargo plane crashed while landing. According to local officials, the Boeing 767 aircraft overran the runway at approximately 2:00 p.m. local time. The plane, which had arrived from San Juan, Puerto Rico, continued past the end of the runway and came to a stop in a field near the airport fence. During the event, the aircraft struck several vehicles and caught fire, creating a dangerous scene for first responders.
paragraphs.zh: 週日，邁阿密國際機場發生一起嚴重事故，一架亞馬遜（Amazon）貨機在降落時墜毀。根據當地官員說法，這架波音七六七（Boeing 767）客機在當地時間下午兩點左右衝出跑道。這架從波多黎各聖胡安飛抵的飛機，在跑道盡頭持續滑行，最後停在機場圍欄附近的一處空地。事故過程中，飛機撞上多輛車輛並起火燃燒，對第一線救援人員造成危險的現場環境。

paragraphs.en: At least five people were killed in the crash. Miami-Dade County officials reported that three other individuals were taken to hospitals in critical condition, while two others suffered less severe injuries. It is not yet clear if those who died were members of the flight crew or people who were in the vehicles struck by the plane. Fire rescue teams worked quickly to reach the site, with more than 60 units responding to the emergency. Chief Ray Jadallah of the Miami-Dade Fire Rescue department noted that the pilot and copilot were trapped inside the cockpit, and other victims were stuck inside their vehicles.
paragraphs.zh: 這起墜機事故造成至少五人死亡。邁阿密戴德郡（Miami-Dade County）官員通報，另有三人被送往醫院，情況危急，還有兩人受傷較輕。目前尚不清楚死者是機組人員，還是被飛機撞擊車輛內的民眾。消防救援隊迅速趕往現場，超過六十個單位投入緊急救援。邁阿密戴德消防救援部門的局長雷．賈達拉（Ray Jadallah）指出，正副機師受困於駕駛艙內，其他受害者則受困於車輛中。

paragraphs.en: For several hours after the crash, emergency crews worked to put out the fire and manage a fuel leak from the damaged aircraft. Thick black smoke could be seen rising from the scene, which was captured in videos shared on social media. Despite the fire, the 32-year-old plane appeared to remain mostly in one piece. According to flight-tracking data from Flightradar24, the aircraft had originally been built as a passenger plane before being converted to carry cargo in 2015.
paragraphs.zh: 墜機後數小時，緊急救援人員持續撲滅火勢，並處理受損飛機的燃油外洩問題。社群媒體上分享的影片顯示，現場冒出濃濃黑煙。儘管發生火災，這架機齡三十二年的飛機外觀大致保持完整。根據航班追蹤網站 Flightradar24 的數據，該機最初是作為客機製造，二〇一五年才改裝為貨機。

paragraphs.en: Amazon confirmed that the flight was operated by 21 Air, a contract cargo carrier based in North Carolina. Kelly Nantel, a spokesperson for Amazon, expressed the company's sadness regarding the tragedy. "We’re heartbroken to learn that five people lost their lives in today’s incident," the company stated. Amazon officials added that they are working closely with local authorities to understand what happened and are focused on supporting the families and loved ones of those affected.
paragraphs.zh: 亞馬遜證實，該航班由總部位於北卡羅來納州的合約貨運商「二十一航空」（21 Air）營運。亞馬遜發言人凱莉．南特爾（Kelly Nantel）對這場悲劇表達哀悼。公司聲明表示：「得知今日事故中有五人喪生，我們深感悲痛。」亞馬遜官員補充，正與當地主管機關密切合作以釐清事發經過，並致力於協助受難者家屬與親友。

paragraphs.en: The crash caused significant disruptions at one of the busiest airports in the United States. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued a ground stop—an order preventing planes from taking off or landing—which lasted until late Sunday afternoon. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy warned travelers to expect major delays and potential cancellations. According to data from FlightAware, approximately 250 flights were delayed by the end of the day. The Miami-Dade Aviation Department also reported that all runways and taxiways were closed following the incident.
paragraphs.zh: 這起墜機事故導致美國最繁忙的機場之一運作嚴重中斷。美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）發布了地面停飛令，禁止飛機起降，該命令持續至週日下午晚些時候。運輸部長尚恩．達菲（Sean Duffy）警告旅客，預期將出現大規模延誤與潛在的航班取消。根據 FlightAware 的數據，截至當日結束，約有兩百五十個航班延誤。邁阿密戴德航空部門也通報，事故發生後，所有跑道與滑行道皆已關閉。

paragraphs.en: Local residents near the airport were shocked by the event. Jackson Lee, who owns a shop close to the crash site, told news agencies that he and his colleagues saw smoke rising near the airport fences shortly after the crash. "We hear planes taking off and landing every five minutes," Lee said. "I never thought it could come this close to us."
paragraphs.zh: 機場附近的當地居民對此事件感到震驚。在墜機地點附近經營商店的傑克森．李（Jackson Lee）告訴新聞機構，他和同事在事故發生後不久，就看到機場圍欄附近冒出濃煙。李先生說：「我們每五分鐘就會聽到飛機起降的聲音，我從沒想過這種事會離我們這麼近。」

paragraphs.en: Federal agencies have now begun the difficult work of finding out why the crash happened. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), which investigates major transportation accidents, confirmed it has sent a team to the site to gather evidence. The FAA is also conducting its own investigation. As of now, the exact cause of the runway excursion—when a plane goes off the end or side of a runway—remains unknown. Authorities have promised to provide more information as the investigation moves forward.
paragraphs.zh: 聯邦機構現已展開艱鉅的調查工作，以釐清墜機原因。負責調查重大運輸事故的國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）證實，已派遣團隊前往現場蒐集證據。聯邦航空總署也正在進行獨立調查。截至目前，造成飛機衝出跑道（即飛機偏離跑道盡頭或側邊）的確切原因仍然不明。當局承諾隨著調查進展，將提供更多資訊。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To go beyond the intended limit or area.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於指「氾濫」或「侵擾」，這裡指飛機衝出跑道。文中：the Boeing 767 aircraft overran the runway at approximately 2:00 p.m. local time.

keyTerms.definitionEn: An official order that prevents aircraft from taking off or landing at an airport.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個航空專業術語，但文中特別解釋了其含義，容易被誤認為是普通的「停止」。文中：The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued a ground stop—an order preventing planes from taking off or landing—which lasted until late Sunday afternoon.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Individual groups or vehicles, such as fire trucks or emergency teams, acting as a single entity.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「單位」或「元件」，這裡指消防救災的車輛或小隊。文中：Fire rescue teams worked quickly to reach the site, with more than 60 units responding to the emergency.

quiz.question: What happened to the aircraft after it overran the runway at Miami International Airport?

options.A: It immediately exploded in the air before hitting the ground.
options.B: It struck several vehicles and caught fire in a field near the airport fence.
options.C: It crashed directly into the airport terminal building.
options.D: It safely came to a stop on a secondary runway after losing engine power.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，飛機衝出跑道後，在機場圍欄附近的田野中停下，過程中撞擊了多輛車輛並引發火災。選項 A 錯誤，因為飛機是在降落時衝出跑道，而非在空中爆炸。選項 C 錯誤，文中提到是在田野停下而非撞擊航廈。選項 D 錯誤，飛機並未安全停下，而是發生了嚴重的事故與火災。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, what can be inferred about the impact of the crash on airport operations?

options.A: Only the specific runway where the crash occurred remained closed for the day.
options.B: The airport was completely shut down for the entire week.
options.C: The incident caused widespread travel disruptions, affecting hundreds of flights beyond just the runway closure.
options.D: The crash had no significant effect on other flights because the plane was a cargo aircraft.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，FAA 發布了地面停飛令（ground stop），且機場所有跑道與滑行道皆關閉，導致約 250 個航班延誤，顯示影響範圍廣泛。選項 A 錯誤，因為所有跑道與滑行道皆關閉。選項 B 錯誤，文中僅提到延誤至週日下午，未提及長達一週。選項 D 錯誤，顯然該事故對整體機場運作造成了重大干擾。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the term 'runway excursion' refer to in the context of the accident?

options.A: A scheduled maintenance check of the landing strip.
options.B: A situation where an aircraft goes off the end or side of a runway.
options.C: A rapid increase in speed during the takeoff process.
options.D: The process of converting a passenger plane into a cargo carrier.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章最後一段明確定義了 'runway excursion' 為「當飛機衝出跑道末端或側邊時的情況」。選項 A 與此定義無關。選項 C 描述的是加速過程，而非偏離跑道。選項 D 則是關於飛機改裝的歷史，與本詞彙定義不符。此處透過括號內的解釋，讀者可精確掌握其在航空專業語境下的意義。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this news report?

options.A: To explain the history of Boeing 767 aircraft and their conversion to cargo planes.
options.B: To criticize the safety standards of 21 Air and Amazon's logistics network.
options.C: To provide an update on the local residents' emotional reactions to the crash.
options.D: To report on a fatal cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport and its immediate consequences.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。整篇文章的核心在於報導邁阿密國際機場發生的一起致命貨機墜毀事故，內容涵蓋事故經過、傷亡情況、對機場運作的影響以及後續的調查行動。選項 A 只是文中提到的背景資訊之一。選項 B 並非文章主旨，文中僅陳述事實。選項 C 僅是報導的一小部分，不足以代表全文主旨。故 D 最能概括全文重點。
